name: @hrg/fs-meta
description: The Bun/Node reader for the fs-meta trio: files.meta, files.txt and files.json.
comment: The port needs the wyhash JavaScript implementation only under Node: under Bun the native Bun.hash.wyhash is the same std.hash.Wyhash the engine calls and is used instead, so the dependency is a fallback rather than a second algorithm. It is fetched from the project's own repository, which is the same posture the Java port takes with the published artifact.
comment-gitignore: The .gitignore matcher is gitignore's code, not fs-meta's: this project implements no matcher of its own (AGENTS.md, the core-dependency rule). For local work the dependency is the sibling gitignore checkout through a file: link; the published form is the project's git URL, github.com/hrgdavor/gitignore, exactly as the Java port consumes the released hr.hrg:gitignore artifact rather than a copy.
